title: Smart Taskbar
hint: Click to expand or collapse • Wheel to navigate • Right click for settings
disconnected: No compositor snapshot. Requires API 54 and Umbriel or niri. Right click for settings.
action_failed: The compositor could not complete the window action.
unsupported_action: This compositor does not support the requested action.
launcher_missing: Install gtk-launch to start pinned desktop entries.

expand_mode.label: Behavior: Expansion
expand_mode.description: Whole-widget native hover, click toggle, or always expanded.

collapse_delay.label: Behavior: Collapse delay
collapse_delay.description: Milliseconds before collapsing. Manual sorting stays open until clicked to protect drags.

animations.label: Behavior: Animations
animations.description: Fade newly expanded content. Disable for reduced motion.

animation_duration.label: Behavior: Animation duration
animation_duration.description: Milliseconds for the content fade. No continuous scroll animation is implied.

min_width.label: Dimensions: Minimum width
min_width.description: Minimum expanded extent, clamped to maximum width.

max_width.label: Dimensions: Maximum width
max_width.description: Maximum content extent in logical pixels; use capsule_padding = 0 and scale = 1 for a matching outer budget.

collapsed_width.label: Dimensions: Collapsed width
collapsed_width.description: Stable collapsed extent, clamped to maximum width.

icon_size.label: Dimensions: Icon size
icon_size.description: Logical pixels. Choose a size that fits your bar thickness.

overflow_behavior.label: Dimensions: Overflow navigation
overflow_behavior.description: Wheel navigation replaces visible items; the viewport is clipped.

scroll_step.label: Interaction: Scroll step
scroll_step.description: Application items per wheel gesture in item mode.

auto_reveal_focused.label: Interaction: Reveal focused app
auto_reveal_focused.description: Reveal on focus changes and expansion. Manual wheel navigation remains usable until focus changes.

show_scroll_indicators.label: Appearance: Overflow arrows
show_scroll_indicators.description: Subtle direction indicators inside the width budget.

display_mode.label: Windows: Application display
display_mode.description: Additional workspace and output filters below apply to running windows.

workspace_filter.label: Windows: Workspace filter
workspace_filter.description: Active uses compositor active or focused workspaces; combines with output filtering.

output_filter.label: Windows: Output filter
output_filter.description: Current means this bar instance’s output, not the globally focused monitor.

show_minimized.label: Windows: Include minimized
show_minimized.description: Umbriel reports minimized state; unavailable state is treated as not minimized.

grouping.label: Windows: Grouping
grouping.description: Unknown application IDs remain separate. Workspace groups use a representative application icon.

duplicate_indicator.label: Appearance: Duplicate windows
duplicate_indicator.description: Every grouped window contributes to the count. Dots above three show an overflow mark.

sorting.label: Interaction: Sorting
sorting.description: Launch order means first observed order. Manual order is per instance and resets on reload.

exclusions.label: Windows: Excluded apps
exclusions.description: Exact normalized desktop/application IDs. No shell patterns.

pinned_apps.label: Windows: Pinned apps
pinned_apps.description: Desktop-entry IDs, for example org.mozilla.firefox. gtk-launch is needed only to launch pins.

app_aliases.label: Advanced: Application aliases
app_aliases.description: Map normalized unusual application IDs to desktop-entry IDs. Matching ignores case and a .desktop suffix.

collapsed_label.label: Appearance: Collapsed label
collapsed_label.description: Text is ellipsized within the stable width. Side bars show the icon only.

placeholder.label: Appearance: Empty label
placeholder.description: Shown when there is no focused application. Bounded by collapsed width.

placeholder_glyph.label: Appearance: Empty icon
placeholder_glyph.description: Theme glyph when no application is focused.

capsule_radius.label: Appearance: Capsule radius
capsule_radius.description: Logical pixels for the plugin’s own theme-colored capsule.

opacity.label: Appearance: Capsule opacity
opacity.description: Background alpha only; icons and text stay opaque.

border.label: Appearance: Capsule border
border.description: Use the active theme outline role.

active_indicator.label: Appearance: Highlight focused app
active_indicator.description: Use the theme primary container role.

minimized_indicator.label: Appearance: Dim minimized apps
minimized_indicator.description: Dim a group only when every member is minimized.

urgent_indicator.label: Appearance: Urgency border
urgent_indicator.description: Use the theme error role when compositor events provide urgency. Umbriel does not guarantee this field.

badge_placement.label: Appearance: Badge placement
badge_placement.description: A fixed count lane prevents layout shifts. Badges are inline, not absolute overlays.

click_behavior.label: Interaction: Left click
click_behavior.description: Grouped apps always cycle windows. Minimize requires compositor support.

middle_click.label: Interaction: Middle click
middle_click.description: Host defaults to widget settings. To use these actions, explicitly set this instance’s actions.middle = "none".

refresh_fallback.label: Advanced: Retry interval
refresh_fallback.description: Seconds between idle subscription retries if a supported compositor could not subscribe. No subprocess polling.

diagnostic_logging.label: Advanced: Diagnostic logging
diagnostic_logging.description: Log subscription and action errors. Window titles are not logged.

compositor_compatibility.label: Advanced: Compositor compatibility
compositor_compatibility.description: Unsupported compositors show a placeholder. API 54 is required even in automatic mode.
